name: Aaron Ford

lean.basis: Democratic Nevada Senate leader, two-term Democratic attorney general and governor-elect.

current_role: Attorney general of Nevada; governor-elect (takes office January 4, 2027)
summary: Aaron Ford, a former math teacher and lawyer, led Democrats in the Nevada Senate and has been the state's attorney general since 2019, suing the Trump administration more than 40 times in 2025. He defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo in 2026 and will be Nevada's first Black governor. Nevada votes early in the 2028 Democratic calendar, and he has urged contenders to campaign there often.

sources.title: The new Democratic power brokers 2028 hopefuls need to know — The Hill

timeline.role: Nevada state senator; minority leader (2014–2016), majority leader (2016–2018)

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: As Nevada attorney general, Ford sued the Trump administration more than 40 times in 2025, mostly in multistate coalitions: over tariffs, the dismantling of the Education Department, frozen school grants, election rules and funding conditions.
